subject: Consolidating two short demos into a single session for SunrisePay
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Summers <ellie@sunrisepay.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Consolidating two short demos into a single session for SunrisePay

Hi Ellie,

Quick note — I see we have two back-to-back 15-minute walkthroughs on Tue that were split for separate stakeholder groups. Our SE (Connor) will be traveling that day and asked if we can consolidate into a single, focused 35-minute session so he can cover both areas without hopping between rooms.

Proposed: Tue, Dec 7 · 10:00–10:35 AM PT — consolidated demo covering:
- 10:00–10:10 AM: Goals & priorities (AE)
- 10:10–10:30 AM: Live demo (SE)
- 10:30–10:35 AM: Next steps / Qs

Attached a one-pager agenda and the latest deck for context. If the two stakeholder groups prefer separate content, we can keep them split — I wanted to float the consolidation as a time-saver since Connor's travel makes back-to-back less practical.

Would that work for your team? If a different time is better, send a couple of options and we’ll adjust.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SunrisePay-deck-v2.pptx (pptx), consolidated-demo-agenda.pdf (pdf)

From: Ellie Summers <ellie@sunrisepay.com>

Cc: Team <team@sunrisepay.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2026 11:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidating two short demos into a single session for SunrisePay

Hi Monica — thanks for the heads up.

We do have two distinct stakeholder groups (Payments Ops and Platform) and they were expecting slightly different focuses. That said, we can probably combine if you keep the platform-specific bits concise and allow a few minutes for targeted questions. 35 minutes sounds tight but doable.

Can you shift it 30 minutes later (10:30–11:05 AM PT)? The COO wants to join toward the end and is only free after 11. If you can move it we'll share the invite internally.

Also — Priyom, can you make sure the platform deep-dive is pared down to the top three items? We don't need end-to-end architecture in this session.

Cheers,
Ellie Summers
Director, Strategic Accounts — Sunrise Pay
ellie@sunrisepay.com

Thanks Ellie — 10:30–11:05 AM PT works. We’ll compress the platform section to the top three items and leave extra time at the end for the COO’s q’s.

I updated the agenda (attached) and sent a tentative Google Calendar invite. Link to the event: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=consolidated-demo-20261207.

Priyom — can you lead the 10:30–10:40 AM priority framing and then hand off to Connor for the demo? Connor, if you want to focus on integration patterns + KV-cache behavior, that would align with Platform's asks (Ellie flagged integration + reliability).

If anything else comes up we can slice out the payments-specific flow and follow up with a short recording for Payments Ops.

Monica Patel
